title: Snapshot
description: Verifiable reproduction descriptor for a View per spec.md §5.8 + ADR-0025. NOT a complete copy of the world; sufficient to reproduce the View on a compatible kernel.

namespace_config.description: Routing table: which resources are mounted where.

delta_layer_bytes.description: Class A resources' local COW state.

effects_hash.description: Pending Class B + C effects buffer hash at snapshot time.

version_refs.description: Map<Path, VersionRef> of Class B resources' version anchors. At restore: assert each is still valid; on mismatch, raise explicit warning (NOT silent proceed).

capability_set.description: The View's authority boundary at snapshot time.

schema_version.description: Schema version of this snapshot (e.g., '2026-Q3'). For cross-version validation.

x-reel-status: v0.1 canonical (per ADR-0025). Replaces pre-ADR-0024 schema that was a Store-snapshot metadata file (block_count/ref_count); now matches spec.md §5.8 Snapshot type.
